title: NVIDIA/Model-Optimizer: compress and accelerate models for deployment
friendlyTitle: NVIDIA Model Optimizer makes AI models smaller and faster
summary: NVIDIA Model Optimizer combines quantisation, distillation, pruning, speculative decoding and related deployment techniques in one library. It targets inference stacks including TensorRT, TensorRT-LLM and vLLM.
friendlySummary: This library provides several ways to reduce model size and speed up model responses. It works with common NVIDIA and open inference systems.
whyItMatters: Teams deploying their own models can use it to test smaller or faster variants against quality and latency requirements. Benchmark on the real workload: compression gains and accuracy losses vary by model, hardware and task.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Use it to test whether a model can run faster or more cheaply. Always check the result on your own tasks because quality may change.
